summary: NordBank AB: request data residency exception for DR failover (EU -> US)
description:
Customer asks for a temporary exception to EU-only residency to allow US failover during disaster recovery tests and if EU region is degraded. They want a written confirmation of what data may cross regions and confirmation that payload logging is disabled.

Impact: None currently; this is a compliance/architecture request tied to procurement.

Environment: Hosted API, tenant=nordbank-prod, primary region=eu-west.
comments:
[2025-02-13] Camila Reyes (reporter): Customer procurement is blocked until we confirm if our failover can ever route to US. They are ok with time-bounded exception + logging disabled, but need it in writing.

[2025-02-14] Jonas Weber (assignee): Looping in #eng-security and #support for review. We can enforce tenant-level routing allowlist and confirm payload logging is disabled.

[2025-02-15] Aisha Rahman (Security): Approved exception with controls. Please link the exception record and ensure customer confirmation is sent.

[2025-02-17] Jonas Weber: Implemented tenant override: allow us-east as fallback only when eu-west is degraded OR during scheduled DR test window. Verified gateway log config: payload logging disabled for tenant in both regions.

[2025-02-19] Camila Reyes: Sent customer-facing confirmation via email. Closing ticket.
